The OPT-IN, ABI-pinned Cua Driver Hyprland plugin for isolated background
input — built for the exact Hyprland version/toolchain the guest runs. It is
deliberately NOT a dependency of cua-driver/cua-session: the plugin has no
stable ABI and must be rebuilt on every Hyprland upgrade, so only a bed or box
that wants isolated input composes it. Built from the pinned trycua/cua source
against the guest's Hyprland headers, and fail-closed at load (the plugin's own
ABI hash must match the compositor's). Verifiable on the built image: the .so
exists and the Hyprland config loads it.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | build the Cua Hyprland plugin from the pinned source against the guest's Hyprland (ABI-pinned; skipped where Hyprland headers are absent) |
| `run` | load the plugin from the desktop user's Hyprland config (last, so the qualified layout is explicit) |
| `check` | the opt-in plugin ships its load config, and the .so is present when the guest has Hyprland |
| `check` | the plugin is actually WIRED into the compositor's config (not merely present) |
